text:
alice: getting a flood of 502/504s from hosted inference for tenant=brightdoc. support ticket volume spiking, customers reporting timeouts. p95 tail latency > 30s. :grimacing:
support-bot: new escalation INC-1023 created for tenant brightdoc (severity=high) :rotating_light:
metrics-bot: grafana: https://grafana.company/r/hosted/queues?panel=ingress_queue_depth - queue_depth ~ 1.2k, continuous_batcher_backlog 82%, early_reject_rate 0.0%
alice: sample curl ->

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" -d '{"input":"short prompt"}' https://api.redwood-hosted.com/v1/generate
# response: 504 Gateway Timeout
# headers: x-request-id: r-9423e
```
ben: seeing matching logs on gateway: `gateway.enqueue_depth=1247 action=enqueue result=ok` then later `gateway.dequeue_timeout request_id=r-9423e reason=deadline_exceeded`
carmen: likely continuous-batcher backlog + queue depth limit. early_reject isn't configured for this tenant. when queue gets past high watermark things just sit waiting for KV cache / batchers to free up.
derek: oncall - can we repro with a short load script? idea: many small requests will saturate batching and kv cache spinups -> tail latencies.
ben: repro snippet (run in a separate machine):
```
# quick Python stress repro
import requests,concurrent.futures
URL='https://api.redwood-hosted.com/v1/generate'
HEADERS={'Authorization':'Bearer $REDACTED'}
def call():
  return requests.post(URL,json={'input':'hello'},headers=HEADERS,timeout=20)
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=300) as e:
  for _ in range(1200):
    e.submit(call)
```
ben: you'll see queue_depth climb and then 502/504s.
infra-bot: autoscale action started: adding 4 gpu-pool nodes to hosted-pool-brightdoc (reason: ingress_queue_depth>1000).
metrics-bot: note: continuous_batcher_backlog jump correlates with model variant mv-2.3-large deployment yesterday.
carmen: short-term mitigations:
- enable early_reject_threshold=512 for tenant brightdoc
- lower batch_max_tokens to reduce wait time
- temporarily increase max_workers for hosted-pool
- enable fallback to mv-2.3-medium until backlog clears
ben: commands to flip early_reject (prod config API):
```
# (prod-admin)
POST /admin/tenants/brightdoc/config
{ "early_reject_threshold": 512 }
```
derek: I applied early_reject and bumped pool size. infra-bot confirmed scaling +4 nodes. monitoring shows queue_depth dropping from 1.2k -> 420 in ~90s :eyes:
alice: getting fresh customer reports saying improvements, p95 dropped to ~700ms now. Will keep monitoring.
support-bot: updated ticket INC-1023 with mitigation steps and follow-up action: add tenant-specific early_reject defaults, alert when continuous_batcher_backlog > 60% for >5m.
carmen: follow-up TODOs (assign):
- audit which tenants have no early_reject (owner: ben)
- add automated rollback to medium model variant for large MV spikes (owner: alice)
- postmortem draft and action items (owner: carmen)
alice: thanks all. saving logs and traces (r-9423e) into escalation doc. closing here once stability is confirmed. :white_check_mark:
